summary.intent: Complete Phase 40 (Desktop Vault Settings Integration) of the GSD roadmap, then fix a leaky abstraction where versioning logic was duplicated between macOS/Linux and Windows platform paths.
summary.outcome: Phase 40 was completed successfully. The duplicated versioning logic was extracted into a shared function in helpers.rs, eliminating the duplication between read_ops.rs (macOS/Linux) and platform/windows/write_ops.rs. Both the fuse crate and desktop app compiled cleanly after the refactor.

repo: The fuse crate uses a feature gate (`fuse` feature) to unify macOS and Linux paths, while Windows uses WinFSP with a separate platform directory under crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/.

macOS/Linux use the fuser crate's release() callback in read_ops.rs for upload-on-close, while Windows uses WinFSP's cleanup() callback in write_ops.rs — this structural difference caused the versioning logic duplication.
helpers.rs is the designated platform-agnostic shared module in the fuse crate.

code.finding: Contained duplicated versioning logic (cooldown check, version entry construction, pruning) that was nearly identical to the Windows implementation. Replaced with a call to the new shared helper.

Contained duplicated versioning logic. Variables were underscore-prefixed (_old_encrypted_key, _old_iv) to suppress unused warnings — prefixes needed removal after extraction since they became actually used arguments.
New shared function create_version_entry_and_prune() added here to unify versioning logic across all desktop platforms.

workflow: The assistant initially made an incorrect claim that Linux desktop support was deferred, then retracted it after reading the code — verifying platform coverage claims against code rather than assumptions.
Underscore-prefixed variables in Rust (_var) suppress unused warnings; when extracting shared functions, these prefixes must be removed if the variables are now passed as arguments.

friction: Assistant made an incorrect conversational claim about Linux support not being shipped, requiring a retraction after code inspection.
The versioning duplication was an artifact of Phase 40 implementation that should have been caught during that phase rather than discovered post-completion.
open_items: The GSD roadmap is now fully complete — next steps would be creating a PR via /gsd:ship for Phase 40 including the versioning refactor.
